element.name: Write a hand-over note
element.instructions:
Write a note for whoever continues {{task}} after you, a person or another agent, who knows nothing about this conversation.

Say, in this order: what the goal is; what is done and can be relied on; what is started and not finished, and where it stands; what you would do next; anything that surprised you.

Keep it to what they need. Leave out what they can read in the code.
element.doneWhen: Someone who reads only the note can carry on without asking what happened.
